answer: The sun heats the ocean, which makes the water rise as vapor.
High up, the vapor cools into clouds (the Condensation stage).
Evaporation, then Condensation, then Precipitation, then Collection (and then back around).

At the very end the diagram stayed on screen under the title 'One endless loop'. The stage boxes lit up red one after another in turn (Evaporation, Condensation, Precipitation, Collection), and then all four were red together, as the loop kept going around.
